title: Prompt branch selection must use the effective is_prompt tag value, not tag presence
answers: prompt validation skipped when is_prompt tag is false
duplicate is_prompt tags on model version create
model version with is_prompt false treated as prompt
why does create model version skip run source validation
body:
Invariant: the prompt branch of _create_model_version is chosen only by _is_prompt_request. It collapses request tags into a dict keyed by tag key, with the last value winning, and requires the value to be "true" case-insensitively. This matches the entity-side ModelVersion._is_prompt.
What breaks: with a tag-presence check, an is_prompt value of "false" or a duplicate [true, false] pair skipped _validate_source_run and _validate_source_model. The request was then treated as a prompt by the webhook and validation path while the persisted entity was not a prompt.
Enforced at mlflow/server/handlers.py:_is_prompt_request. Non-true prompt tags fall through to the regular model source validation.
applies: Any change to how CreateModelVersion requests are classified as prompt or regular model versions.
says: A standard model version skipped source run validation because it contained an inactive prompt tag.
Models tagged with prompt equals false incorrectly bypass normal experiment run validation checks.
Handle conflicting prompt tags on new model versions by using the final tag value provided.
Enforce standard model source validation when the prompt indicator is not explicitly set to true.
Registered models trigger prompt webhooks even though the saved entity is a regular model.
search: In mlflow/server/handlers.py:_create_model_version, requests are classified as prompts strictly through _is_prompt_request using the effective case-insensitive 'true' value of the is_prompt tag, matching ModelVersion._is_prompt. Checking tag presence rather than effective value previously allowed is_prompt='false' or duplicate tags to skip _validate_source_run and _validate_source_model and misroute requests through prompt webhook and validation paths. Any request without an effective 'true' prompt tag falls through to standard model source validation.
